zh-CN.title: 《论语》
zh-CN.subtitle: 孔门言行与儒家经典文本
zh-CN.shortSummary: 《论语》通过孔子及其弟子言行保存早期儒家伦理、教育和政治讨论。
curatorialDescription: 《论语》不是一个脱离编纂历史的单一作者文本；它在传播、注释和国家教育中不断获得新的制度语境。
zh-CN.researchNote: 篇章形成、传本和注疏关系将在 text-version 与 commentary 数据中继续细化。
zh-CN.timeLabel: 编纂与流传：战国至汉代区间

en.title: Analects
en.subtitle: Sayings and actions associated with Confucius and his disciples
en.shortSummary: The Analects preserves early Confucian discussions of ethics, education and politics through sayings and encounters associated with Confucius and his disciples.
curatorialDescription: The Analects is not a text outside compilation history. Its transmission, commentaries and use in state education gave it new institutional contexts over time.
en.researchNote: Formation, editions and commentary relationships will be refined through the text-version and commentary data model.
en.timeLabel: Compilation and circulation: Warring States to Han ranges
